messages:
maria: Noticed RN WebView stream drops when ephemeral token rotates while app is backgrounded.
jon: Same. Server returns 401 and WS closes, no reconnect.
lee: Can you paste repro steps + logs?
maria: Repro: start stream, background app ~20-40s, foreground, send msg -> server 401 then close. No auto-retry.
alex: iOS WKWebView here. We inject a fresh token on foreground before opening WS; helped.
lee: How are you sending token? header vs query vs cookie? CORS differs per approach.
maria: Using Authorization header via fetch then upgrade. Preflight seems to race with refresh.
jon: Options: 1) ephemerals in query param at handshake to avoid preflight, 2) set cookie SameSite=None Secure via native bridge, 3) native wrapper injects window token.
lee: Reminder: query tokens can leak in referer; add short TTL and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.
maria: Snippet that worked for us:

```
// inject token then open ws
const t = await fetch('/session').then(r=>r.text());
const ws = new WebSocket(`wss://api.redwood.internal/stream?e=${encodeURIComponent(t)}`);
```

jon: SDK proposal: add streamAuth: 'header'|'query'|'cookie', autoRefresh once on 401, and onAuthRefresh hook for wrappers. Will PR.
mobile-eng: On Android file:// webviews, enable setAllowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs(true) or run a local dev server; otherwise CORS/credentials blocked.
alex: For Swift/Kotlin wrappers expose onForeground hook to re-inject token sync before WS handshake; a 100-300ms delay helps.
lee: Add telemetry event when stream closes with code/reason and mark if last status was 401.
maria: I'll open GH issue with logs + repro and link this thread.
jon: I'll draft SDK PR, opt-in reconnect-on-401 flag default false for now. @sdk-team please review.
ci-bot: deploy job scheduled -> staging 2026-03-18T02:00Z :gear:
maria: thanks :thumbsup:
